description:
The storage->materializer rename left dead paths: storage.md's Location is lib/bedrock/data_plane/storage.ex (does not exist; actual: materializer.ex); basalt paths were removed in qzr.6 but other guides still cite lib/bedrock/data_plane/storage/... and line-numbered refs that have drifted (deep-dives/transactions.md: 'Storage fetch: storage.ex:33', 'Local write storage: lib/bedrock/cluster/gateway/transaction_builder/state.ex:16' — the transaction_builder now lives under lib/bedrock/internal/). Sweep every backtick code path and :line reference in guides/ against the tree; prefer module names over line numbers so refs do not rot.

## Merged from bedrock-5tq.1 (closed as duplicate, 2026-09-06)

bedrock-5tq.1 was filed for gateway.md, which 8+ guides linked to and which never existed. That headline is now moot: no guide links gateway.md any more, and the component was renamed rather than documented, so the answer is repointing, not writing a new deep-dive. Its surviving clause, "also sweep for other targets that do not exist", is the same sweep this ticket asks for, so the two are one job.

Verified state of guides/ at a8886156:

- 7 broken doc-to-doc links. Two quick-reads point at deep-dives/architecture/infrastructure/README.md, which does not exist. Three in deep-dives/architecture.md use ../ where the sibling is in the same directory. Two in deep-dives/cluster-startup.md use ../../../ and escape the repository entirely.
- 8 broken code-path links, all relative links into lib/ that are one directory level off, e.g. the Source line at the top of resolver.md, log.md, sequencer.md, commit-proxy.md, director.md, coordinator.md and transaction-builder.md.
- 9 surviving .ex:<line> references, all in deep-dives/transactions.md. Two of them now land on blank lines.

Doing this once should cover all three classes: resolve every relative link against the tree, and replace line-numbered references with function names so they stop rotting.

comments.text: From the PR #175 cold audit (2026-08-20): guides/quick-reads/transaction-system-layout.md:44-55 now definitively lies - it shows id/director/rate_keeper (deleted by q67.9's final layer), storage_teams (long gone), and %TransactionSystemLayout{} struct syntax (it is a plain map); line 62 and guides/quick-reads/recovery/transaction-system-layout.md:38 cite transaction_system_layout_phase.ex which does not exist (now topology_phase.ex). The TSL is now wiring-only (epoch/sequencer/proxies/resolvers/logs/services - ClientDBInfo analogue); shard topology rides the keyspace and proxy-served routing.

Audit 2026-09-06: every stale path named here is gone (storage.ex, cluster/gateway/transaction_builder, transaction_system_layout_phase, storage_teams/rate_keeper in the TSL quick-read), and all lib/ and test/ paths cited in guides/ now exist. Remaining scope: the 9 :line references in deep-dives/transactions.md (server.ex:110, finalization.ex:257/421/522/602/744/829/856, log.ex:56) have drifted; finalization.ex:257 and :856 are blank lines. Replace with function names.

title: Dead code paths and stale line-number references across guides
